units.source_text: 有一时，父母亲等看见柏木病情略有好转，便退出病室。

en.t: At one point, his parents and the others saw that Kashiwagi's condition had improved a little, and they withdrew from the sickroom.

units.source_text: 柏木就在此时写信与三公主。

en.t: It was then that Kashiwagi wrote a letter to the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 信中言道：“我病今已濒危，自知大限将临。

en.t: In the letter he wrote, "My illness has now reached a dangerous point, and I know that my final hour is near.

units.source_text: 此种情况，想你必然早已闻知。

en.t: I imagine you must already have heard of this state of affairs.

units.source_text: 你连我致病之由都不知道，原是难怪之事。

en.t: It is only natural that you do not even know the cause of my illness.
But I truly cannot bear this suffering!"

units.source_text: 那手抖得厉害，欲写之言不能尽写，但赠诗云：

en.t: His hand was shaking so badly that he could not write all he wished to say, but he sent this poem:
